text: Pogačar has methodically dismantled every threat since Alpe d'Huez, but the shortened stage 21 has stripped away the mountains where his dominance is absolute—now it's a sprint-finish sprint where Evenepoel's team can dictate tempo and potentially isolate the yellow jersey if Red Bull-Bora coordinates properly. Pedersen's points lead gives Lidl-Trek a reason to chase any early break, which could either disrupt UAE's control or hand them a gift if no one commits; watch whether Evenepoel burns energy chasing shadows or conserves for a tactical finale on the Montmartre repeats. The wildfires that forced the route change have compressed the final act into a dead-flat power stage, eliminating any climbing reprieve where Evenepoel might have carved back time—this is a day built for aggressive defending, not heroic comebacks.
